subject: Mutual action plan: LumaHealth small-batch pilot & steward assignments
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Park <kelly@lumahealth.com>, Marc Dunn <marc.dunn@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & next steps for the small-batch pilot

Hi Kelly / Marc —

Thanks again for the signature. Attached are the signed SOW (SOW_Luma_20280701.pdf) and an initial mutual action plan (Luma_MVP_MutualActionPlan.xlsx) that outlines the first 3-week pilot cadence. High level:

- Pilot scope: 3 models (search, triage, and summaries) behind our private deployment with token-limited test data.
- Success criteria: <10% failure rate on requests, average latency < 350ms p95, and validation of two production workflows using Redwood embeddings.
- Timeline (tentative): kick-off week of 7/10, integration window 7/11–7/17, internal validation 7/18–7/24, go/no-go checkpoint 7/25.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the two datasets we should mirror for the pilot (production IDs or sample buckets).
2) Confirm a primary technical contact for integration testing.

Internal note: Tessa, Monica — I’d like us to treat this as a small-batch pilot with tight timeboxes. Please see the attached MAP and propose a steward roster.

Thanks — I’ve included a DocuSign link in the HUB record for the final SOW milestone.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0198

Attachments: SOW_Luma_20280701.pdf (pdf), Luma_MVP_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kelly Park <kelly@lumahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marc Dunn <marc.dunn@lumahealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & next steps for the small-batch pilot

Thanks Aditya — this looks good and we can hit the timeline in principle. Quick clarifying questions before we lock dates: 

- Datasets: we can provide the two sample buckets (prod-samples-1 and prod-samples-2). Will those be sufficient?
- SSO / access: we have an Okta team lead (Marc) who will need SAML metadata. When will you need that by?
- Pilot scale: can you confirm token and rate limits for the pilot so our platform team can provision a sandbox?

Also — who from Redwood will own the day-to-day integration and first-line escalations? We’d like a single point of contact.

Kelly Park
Head of Integrations | LumaHealth
kelly@lumahealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & next steps for the small-batch pilot (internal)

Internal only — selecting stewards and early risk callouts.

Thanks team — based on the technical ask and timeline I propose the following roles:

- Customer Success Owner (post-sale): Tessa Morgan — primary for business checkpoints, success criteria, and go/no-go.
- Implementation Lead: Monica Patel — owns integration runs, test harness, and KV/cache placement.
- Platform/Support Escalation: Vivek Kulkarni — owns infra-level fallbacks (dedicated vs hosted), capacity, and the fallback routing policy.

Risk notes:
- SSO: Kelly mentioned Okta; Monica, we’ll need SAML metadata by 7/8 to avoid slipping the 7/11 integration window.
- Data access: confirm that prod-samples-1/2 are anonymized; legal sign-off if PII appears could add 3–5 business days.
- Quant inference profile: we may need to pin a quantized variant to meet the 350ms p95 — expect 1 day of kernel tuning during staging.

Action items (internal):
- Monica: draft the integration checklist and required credentials by 7/5.
- Tessa: propose recurring cadence (weekly 30m) and the 7/10 kick-off invite.
- Vivek: pre-check GPU pool availability for a small reserved capacity window 7/11–7/25.

I’ll reply to the customer with steward assignments and the kickoff options.

—Aditya

> On Mon, Jul 1, 2028 at 10:03 AM Kelly Park <kelly@lumahealth.com> wrote:
> > Thanks Aditya — this looks good and we can hit the timeline in principle...

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Park <kelly@lumahealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & next steps for the small-batch pilot — kickoff availability & questions

Hi Kelly / Marc — pleased to meet you (virtually). I’m Tessa, I’ll be the Customer Success Owner for the pilot. Short intro: I run post-sale engagements and will coordinate success criteria and executive check-ins.

Kickoff availability: 7/10 at 10am PT or 7/11 at 9am PT — which works better for your team?

Pre-kickoff questions to accelerate setup:
- Data: please share sample file links or S3 paths (prod-samples-1, prod-samples-2). We need confirmation that samples are de-identified.
- SSO: Marc, could you share the Okta IdP metadata endpoint or a test user by 7/8?
- API quotas: what request volume should we emulate in the integration window (requests/sec)?
- Acceptance tests: please confirm two representative flows we should validate (we suggest: triage pipeline and daily summary job).

I’ve attached a one-page kickoff checklist (stub) that covers credentials, endpoint tests, and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute recurring standup after kickoff (weekly, short sync).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com

Attachments: kickoff-checklist-onepager.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Park <kelly@lumahealth.com>, Marc Dunn <marc.dunn@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & next steps for the small-batch pilot — owners & immediate next steps

Kelly / Marc — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming the sample buckets offline. Final steward recap and next steps: 

Owners (confirmed):
- Customer Success (exec & outcome): Tessa Morgan (tessa@redwood.com) — recurring weekly sync, success criteria, reporting.
- Implementation (tech lead): Monica Patel (monica@redwood.com) — integration checklist, test harness, runbook.
- Platform escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek@redwood.com) — reserved capacity and fallback routing.

Customer asks & Redwood response: 
- SSO/Okta: Marc, please send SAML metadata or provide a test user by 7/8. Monica will consume the metadata and prepare a test SAML config.
- Token/rate limits: pilot quotas will be 10 reqs/sec with 200k token monthly cap; we’ll provision a small dedicated pool and adjust if needed.
- Datasets: we’ll validate prod-samples-1 and prod-samples-2 in staging; confirm they are de-identified.

Action items and deadlines: 
1) Kelly / Marc: provide SAML metadata + sample paths by 7/8 (OWNER: customer).
2) Monica: integration checklist & test harness by 7/5 (OWNER: Monica).
3) Tessa: calendar invite for 7/10 kickoff (OWNER: Tessa).
4) Vivek: confirm reserved GPU pool capacity for 7/11–7/25 by 7/6.

I’ve attached the final SOW and Mutual Action Plan to the HubSpot deal and pushed the DocuSign milestone per the SOW. Hub record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4982 — please comment there for any contract questions.

If anything changes on ETA, ping me and we’ll triage. Looking forward to a smooth pilot.

—Aditya
